title: Bolt: Request a Ride - Apps on Google Play

facts.fact: Bolt's Google Play listing shows an average user rating of 4.8.
Bolt's Google Play listing shows 11.1 million reviews.
Bolt's Google Play listing shows more than 100 million downloads.
The Bolt app lets users schedule a trip in advance from 30 minutes to 90 days before the expected pickup time.
facts.quote: schedule your trip in advance from 30 minutes to 90 days before your expected pickup time.

facts.fact: Bolt states that it is committed to a carbon net zero goal by 2040.
facts.quote: We're committed to our carbon net zero goal by 2040.

facts.fact: Bolt states that its app accepts payment by credit/debit card, Google Pay, or cash.
facts.quote: pay securely using a credit/debit card, Google Pay, or cash.

facts.fact: Bolt's listed ride types include Comfort, Premium, Electric, and XL, among others.
facts.quote: Choose from various ride types to suit your needs (Comfort, Premium, Electric, XL, and more).

facts.fact: Bolt's Google Play data safety section states that no data is shared with third parties.
facts.quote: No data shared with third parties

facts.fact: Bolt's Google Play data safety section says the app may collect Personal info, Audio, and two other data types.
Bolt's Google Play listing was updated on Nov 6, 2026.
Bolt's own page states that some of its safety features require the app to run in the background.
facts.quote: Some of Bolt’s safety features require the app to run in the background.

facts.fact: Bolt's own page states that its Bolt Drive car-sharing service is increasing its lineup of electric and hybrid cars.
facts.quote: we're increasing the lineup of electric and hybrid cars in Bolt Drive, our car-sharing service.

facts.fact: Bolt's own page states that options differ by location and users should check the app for availability in their city.
facts.quote: Bolt options differ by location. Check the app for availability in your city.
